# chess-library

Upstream: <https://github.com/Disservin/chess-library>

Documentation: <https://disservin.github.io/chess-library/>

Vendored revision: `53e6a841dcda7059a2af363d85f785ef1817304a`

`chess.hpp` is an unmodified copy of upstream `include/chess.hpp` at that
revision. The upstream MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

The header is compiled as a system include so strict warning flags apply to
this project's code without requiring edits to the dependency. No dependency
fetch takes place at build time.
